/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization with pickle
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization-pickle
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("cPickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation using pickle that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization using pickle that could execute arbitrary code when loading untrusted data

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe file operations
 * @description File operations that use paths from function parameters without validation
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-file-operation
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-073
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rmdir", "removedirs"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["rmtree", "copy", "copy2", "copyfile", "move"]).getACall()
  ) and
  exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
    arg = call.getArg(0) and
    arg.asCfgNode().getNode() instanceof Name
  )
select call, "File operation that may use controllable path without validation."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe file operations with potentially controllable paths
